items.title: 12.5.2 Formation of peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) (PANs ka banna) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.5.2 with Figures 12.4 and 12.5 and Quick Check 12.2, printed pages 277-278.

blocks.text: NOₓ reactions ki ek series (silsile) mein hissa leta hai jis se ozone (O₃), aldehydes, peroxyacyl nitrates (PANs) aur peroxybenzoyl nitrate (PBN) bante hain. PAN peroxyacyl nitrates ki family (khandan) ka ek member hai; is ki aam structure (banawat) Figure 12.4 mein hai.

blocks.alt: Structure: R ek C se jura hai jis ke oopar double bond wala O hai; C ek O se, woh O doosre O se, aur woh N se jura hai. N par + charge hai, right side double bond wala O aur neeche single bond wala O jis par negative charge hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.4: PANs ki aam structure (kitab ki Figure 12.4 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Is structure ke teen hisse hain: R-C(=O)- acyl group, beech mein -O-O- peroxy link (jor), aur aakhir mein -NO2 (nitro) group. Is liye aam formula RC(O)OONO2 hai. Jab R = CH3 ho to yeh peroxyacetyl nitrate (PAN) hai.
Peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R group CH₃ hai, lekin is ki jagah doosri hydrocarbon chains (zanjeer) bhi ho sakti hain.

PAN kaise banta hai, yeh Figure 12.5 mein dikhaya gaya hai. Oxidising smog ka sab se bara hissa ozone hai, jo hydrocarbon ko oxidise kar ke aldehyde banati hai. Phir aldehyde hydroxyl radical (HO•) se react kar ke acyl radical banata hai. Acyl radical oxygen se react kar ke peroxyacyl radical banata hai, jo aakhir mein nitrogen peroxide (NO₂) se react kar ke peroxyacyl nitrate (PAN) banata hai.

blocks.caption: PAN banne ka mechanism (Figure 12.5)
rows: O₃ hydrocarbon (RCH₃) ko aldehyde (RCHO) mein oxidise karti hai

blocks.alt: Ek ellipse (lamba gol) cycle jis par teer clockwise (ghari ki sooiyon ki taraf) chalte hain. Reactive Hydrocarbon (green box) O3 se RCH2• deta hai jo cycle ke oopar hai; O2 se RCH2O2•; NO se RCH2O• + NO2; O2 se neeche HO2 + RCHO; HO2 aur NO se left side NO2 + HO•; HO• aur RCH3 se dobara RCH2•. RCHO se neeche seedhi chain: OH• se RC•=O, O2 se RC(=O)OO•, NO2 se RC(=O)OONO2.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.5: PAN banne ka mechanism (kitab ki Figure 12.5 jaisa original diagram).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Cycle mein har chakkar NO ko NO2 mein badalta hai aur HO• radical wapas aa jata hai, is liye cycle chalta rehta hai. Aldehyde RCHO cycle se nikal kar neeche wali chain mein jata hai: OH• us se acyl radical RC•=O banata hai, O₂ se peroxyacyl radical RC(O)OO• banta hai, aur NO2 se PAN, RC(O)OONO2.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 12.5 mein teen ghaltiyan hain jo upar ke diagram mein theek ki gayi hain: (1) RCH2• + O₂ ke baad 'RCH2O•' chhapa hai, sahi RCH2O2• hai; (2) aakhri box mein 'OONO3' chhapa hai, sahi OONO2 hai (PAN = RC(O)OONO2); (3) cycle ke left aadhe mein teer ulti direction mein hain, jabke HO2 + NO se NO2 + HO• aur HO• + RCH3 se RCH2• banne ke liye poora cycle ek hi direction mein chalta hai.

blocks.prompt: a) In oxides ki structure banayein aur bonding short mein batayein: i) N₂O ii) NO iii) NO₂.
blocks.explanation: i) N₂O linear hai: N≡N–O (ya N=N=O); nitrogen ki oxidation state +1. ii) NO mein 11 valence electrons (taaq tadaad) hain: N=O double bond aur nitrogen par ek akela (unpaired) electron, is liye paramagnetic; yeh kamzori se jur kar N₂O₂ (dimer) banata hai. iii) NO₂ mura hua (bent) hai, O–N=O, aur nitrogen par ek unpaired electron hai (paramagnetic); do NO₂ molecules N–N bond se jur kar N₂O₄ banate hain.

answer_figure.alt: Teen nitrogen oxides ke Lewis structures: (i) N2O linear, do resonance forms N teen-bond N single-bond O aur N=N=O, formal charges ke saath; (ii) NO, N=O double bond, N par aik lone pair aur aik laal unpaired electron; (iii) NO2 mura hua (bent), O=N-O, angle 134 degree, N par aik laal unpaired electron, N par + aur single-bond O par - charge.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram: N₂O (linear, do resonance forms), NO (N=O, aik unpaired electron) aur NO₂ (bent, O=N–O, aik unpaired electron) ki structure.
answer_figure.long_description: Pehli line mein N₂O ke do resonance structures hain: :N≡N⁺–O⁻ aur ⁻N=N⁺=O; dono linear hain. Doosri line mein NO hai: N=O double bond, nitrogen par aik lone pair aur aik akela (unpaired) electron (laal dot), kul 11 valence electrons. Teesri line mein NO₂ hai: mura hua (bent) molecule, O=N–O, bond angle taqreeban 134°; nitrogen par aik unpaired electron (laal dot), nitrogen par + aur single bond wale oxygen par − formal charge. Unpaired electron ki wajah se NO aur NO₂ paramagnetic hain.

blocks.prompt: b) PAN ka matlab kya hai? Is ka aam formula dein.
blocks.explanation: PAN = peroxyacyl nitrate (jab R = CH₃ ho to peroxyacetyl nitrate). Aam formula RC(O)OONO₂.

blocks.prompt: c) PAN banane wale compounds ke formulas likhein.
blocks.explanation: Hydrocarbons (VOCs, masalan RCH₃), ozone O₃, hydroxyl radical HO•, oxygen O₂ aur nitrogen dioxide NO₂.

blocks.prompt: d) Jalta magnesium N₂O mein jalta rehta hai; is reaction ka product N₂O ki structure ko confirm (tasdeeq) kaise karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Reaction Mg + N₂O → MgO + N₂ hai. Oxygen nikal jane ke baad N₂ molecule bachta hai, yani N₂O mein dono nitrogen atoms aapas mein jure hain aur oxygen ek end par hai: N–N–O, jaisa Table 12.2 mein dikhaya gaya hai.

items: PAN = peroxyacyl nitrate, RC(O)OONO₂; peroxyacetyl nitrate mein R = CH₃.
Hydrocarbon + O₃ → aldehyde; aldehyde + HO• → acyl radical; + O₂ → peroxyacyl radical; + NO₂ → PAN.
